nodes.label: Finding: reference-free scores cannot detect fully corrupted evidence
nodes.description: AUROC for separating 100%-corrupted from clean evidence across 17 runs (Qwen 3B/7B/14B, Llama-8B; FinQA, TAT-QA): all five reference-free measures sit at 0.43-0.60 (pooled 0.49-0.55), i.e. near chance; only support vs clean evidence reaches 0.84-0.94 and gold accuracy 0.59-0.77.
nodes.norm_label: finding: reference-free scores cannot detect fully corrupted evidence
nodes.rationale: If the shown evidence is itself wrong, an answer that matches it still looks supported, so scores that check answer against shown evidence cannot see the corruption.

nodes.label: AUROC with bootstrap CI evaluation method
nodes.description: AUROC with 95% bootstrap interval over items; 0.5 is chance. Used for three questions: corrupted vs clean evidence, correct vs incorrect answer, retrieval hit vs miss.
nodes.norm_label: auroc with bootstrap ci evaluation method

nodes.label: No-hallucination flag
nodes.description: Binary reference-free flag. AUROC ~0.49-0.52 in every corruption condition (pooled 0.50-0.51); correct-vs-incorrect pooled 0.51/0.53; retrieval hit-vs-miss pooled 0.50/0.54 - essentially chance.

nodes.description: Built and test-compiled by .github/workflows/paper.yml, published on paper-pdf branch with main.pdf; contains sources, unmodified ACL style files, figures, generated tables (generated/numbers.tex) and pre-built main.bbl; regenerate with paper/make_arxiv.sh.

nodes.label: Finding: gold-free measures weakly separate correct from incorrect answers
nodes.description: Clean-evidence AUROC for correct vs incorrect: pooled FinQA (n=1175, acc 0.35) overlap 0.46, entailment 0.57, lexical 0.55, judge 0.55, flag 0.51, confidence 0.55; pooled TAT-QA (n=400, acc 0.49) overlap 0.56, entailment 0.60, lexical 0.55, judge 0.61, flag 0.53, confidence 0.64. Overlap support is inverted (0.27-0.39) for larger models; SmolLM2 0.32.
nodes.norm_label: finding: gold-free measures weakly separate correct from incorrect answers
nodes.rationale: Larger models copy numbers from evidence even when wrong, so overlap support stops discriminating.

nodes.label: CPU fp32 re-run README
nodes.description: Documents re-run of experiments 1-5 on free GitHub CPU runners with the corrected scorer.

nodes.label: Support vs clean evidence (reference-based) score
nodes.description: Evidence support computed against the clean (uncorrupted) evidence; requires clean evidence. Detects 100%-corrupted evidence: AUROC 0.84-0.94 (pooled FinQA 0.92 [0.91,0.94], TAT-QA 0.88 [0.85,0.90]). At chance (0.43-0.52) for period/row swaps.
nodes.rationale: Works only because it needs the right text, which the deployed system would not have.

nodes.label: Corrected evidence-support scorer
nodes.description: Evidence-support scorer that no longer counts the model's own 'Confidence: x' value as an unsupported number.
nodes.rationale: Earlier scorer counted the confidence value as an unsupported number, biasing support scores; fixed and all experiments re-run.

nodes.label: Replay engine and generation cache
nodes.description: Generation is slow (mean 118 s per answer, 579 distinct generations), so 20 shard jobs cached answers in generations.jsonl keyed by hash of chat messages; a final job ran unchanged experiment scripts with --engine replay, loading no model and raising on any uncached prompt.
nodes.rationale: Separates slow generation from fast deterministic scoring so results can be re-scored from committed answers.

nodes.label: Self-reported confidence score
nodes.description: Model's own 'Confidence: x'. Corrupted-vs-clean AUROC 0.50-0.58 (pooled 0.53/0.51). Best gold-free signal for correct-vs-incorrect: pooled FinQA 0.55, TAT-QA 0.64 (Llama-8B 0.65, Qwen-7B TAT-QA 0.73). Retrieval hit/miss pooled 0.56 FinQA, 0.68 TAT-QA.

nodes.label: Pre-submission checklist (endorsement, bibliography, AI disclosure)
nodes.description: Needs cs.* endorsement; references.bib checked by web search on 2026-10-28 against ACL Anthology, arXiv, NeurIPS, ICLR; license choice (CC BY 4.0 suggested); tag v1.0-paper and Zenodo DOI after posting.
nodes.rationale: AI-assistance (experiments, code, first draft produced with Claude) must be disclosed in Acknowledgements while the human author remains responsible, per arXiv and ACL policy.

nodes.label: Clean-condition correct-vs-incorrect AUROC at scale
nodes.description: Overlap evidence support 0.30-0.64 (0.30 for Qwen-7B and 0.35 for TAT-QA 7B: inverted; 0.64 on Qwen-3B dev), no-hallucination flag 0.45-0.54, self-reported confidence 0.50-0.73 (best: 0.73 TAT-QA 7B), entailment 0.37-0.61.

nodes.label: Item-level distractor/swap noise effect
nodes.description: Paired item-level change at highest noise vs 0%: Qwen-7B TAT-QA period swap accuracy -0.470 and row swap -0.540 while evidence support changes +0.001/-0.011 (CIs span 0); FinQA 7B swaps accuracy -0.07/-0.14 with support unchanged (-0.002/+0.003). Accuracy drops but support score does not move.

nodes.label: Finding: period-swap and row-swap perturbations are invisible to all scores
nodes.description: Period swap and row swap on Qwen-7B and Llama-8B: every reference-free score AUROC 0.43-0.55, and even support vs clean evidence is 0.50 (0.43 for Llama TAT-QA row swap), because swapped evidence reuses the same numbers.
nodes.norm_label: finding: period-swap and row-swap perturbations are invisible to all scores

nodes.label: Finding: real retrieval errors (gold numbers missing) are hard to detect
nodes.description: Pooled FinQA miss rate 0.16 (161/1000), accuracy hit/miss 0.42/0.07; AUROC overlap 0.47, entailment 0.56, lexical 0.49, judge 0.58, flag 0.50, confidence 0.56, gold accuracy 0.68. Pooled TAT-QA miss rate 0.25 (99/400), accuracy 0.60/0.14; overlap 0.55, entailment 0.63, judge 0.61, confidence 0.68, accuracy 0.73.
nodes.norm_label: finding: real retrieval errors (gold numbers missing) are hard to detect

nodes.label: Decoding-seed spread (generation luck)
nodes.description: Qwen-1.5B at temperature 0.7 over 3 seeds: r(noise, composite) +0.20 +/- 0.50, r(noise, hallucination) -0.74 +/- 0.09, clean accuracy 0.30 +/- 0.03, accuracy change under noise -0.013 +/- 0.085.
nodes.rationale: Shows how much of a single small-model run's number is generation luck.

nodes.label: Weights chosen on dev do not transfer to test
nodes.description: Qwen-1.5B: 56 weightings (3.2%) pass both on dev, 0.0% of those pass on test; Qwen-3B and TAT-3B corrupt: none pass on dev; dev's pick ranks incorrectly on test (dev r -0.77 vs test r -0.70, still False).
nodes.norm_label: weights chosen on dev do not transfer to test

nodes.label: Evaluated generator models
nodes.description: Qwen2.5-1.5B fp32, Qwen2.5-3B fp32, Qwen2.5-7B Q4, Qwen2.5-14B Q4, Llama-3.1-8B Q4, SmolLM2-1.7B fp32.

nodes.label: CPU float32 re-run of experiments 1-5
nodes.description: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in float32 on 4-vCPU Xeon Platinum 8573C runners vs recorded 4-bit NF4 on RTX 3050. Same items, seed, prompts, retrieval, scoring. Of 50 baseline items 15 give the same predicted value and 37 the same correct/incorrect outcome; accuracy fell 0.34 -> 0.20.
nodes.rationale: Replicates the pipeline at a different numeric precision with no GPU or paid API; accuracy drop from 0.34 to 0.20 is itself a measure of how unstable 3B answers are at n=50.

nodes.label: Accuracy (needs gold answer) baseline
nodes.description: Reference-based upper bound: AUROC 0.59-0.77 for separating corrupted from clean responses (pooled FinQA 0.68, TAT-QA 0.73); hit/miss 0.58-0.84.

nodes.label: LLM-judge faithfulness score
nodes.description: Reference-free LLM-judge faithfulness (n/a on several runs). Corrupted-vs-clean AUROC 0.46-0.55, pooled 0.50. Correct-vs-incorrect pooled FinQA 0.55, TAT-QA 0.61.

nodes.label: Entailment (NLI) support score
nodes.description: Reference-free NLI entailment support. Corrupted-vs-clean AUROC 0.46-0.60 (pooled FinQA 0.55, TAT-QA 0.50). Correct-vs-incorrect pooled FinQA 0.57, TAT-QA 0.60; Llama-8B 0.70.

nodes.label: Lexical groundedness score
nodes.description: Reference-free lexical groundedness. Corrupted-vs-clean AUROC 0.45-0.56 (pooled FinQA 0.52, TAT-QA 0.49); correct-vs-incorrect pooled 0.55.

nodes.label: Numeric-overlap evidence support score
nodes.description: Reference-free score: share of the answer's numbers found in the shown evidence. Corrupted-vs-clean AUROC 0.43-0.58 (pooled FinQA 0.54, TAT-QA 0.52). Correct-vs-incorrect pooled FinQA 0.46, TAT-QA 0.56; inverts (<0.5) on larger models: Llama-8B 0.27, Qwen-7B 0.36, Qwen-14B 0.37, but 0.71-0.74 on Qwen-3B TAT-QA.

nodes.label: Corrupted-evidence experiment: only clean-reference support notices
nodes.description: Replacing numbers in retrieved evidence at five levels: accuracy 0%->100% corruption falls 0.48->0.09 (Llama-8B), 0.59->0.09 (14B), 0.55->0.06 (7B), 0.22->0.03 (3B FinQA), 0.38->0.01 (3B TAT-QA), 0.59->0.05 (7B TAT-QA). r(level, composite) -0.90 to -0.97. r(level, support vs clean evidence) -0.99 to -1.00. r(level, support vs shown evidence) inconsistent (+0.35 to -0.97). Item-level shown-evidence support change ~0 (e.g. +0.001 Llama) vs clean-evidence support -0.275 to -0.434.
nodes.norm_label: corrupted-evidence experiment: only clean-reference support notices
nodes.rationale: Unlike injected distractor sentences, corruption genuinely degrades a model that trusts its evidence; question is which measures notice. Only the one given the clean evidence does.

nodes.label: Post claim: accuracy fell 53% to 8% while support score barely moved
nodes.description: Swapping numbers in the evidence for wrong ones dropped accuracy from 53% to 8% while the numeric-overlap support score went from 0.78 to 0.75. Repeated on two datasets and three models; none of five reference-free scores reliably told wrong text from right; comparing with original clean text worked but requires the right text. Also mentions two mistakes in earlier work found and fixed.
nodes.norm_label: post claim: accuracy fell 53% to 8% while support score barely moved
nodes.rationale: If the text itself is wrong, an answer that matches it still looks fine, so the score cannot see the problem.

nodes.label: Weight sensitivity sweep
nodes.description: Sweep over composite-score weightings (python -m experiments.weight_sensitivity --results-dir results/cpu_fp32); output weight_sensitivity_dev*.csv/json.

nodes.description: Two numerical financial QA datasets used: FinQA and TAT-QA.

nodes.label: Composite reliability score
nodes.description: Weighted combination of evidence support, hallucination flag, etc.; tested for tracking distractor noise (r(noise, composite)) and ranking oracle evidence above retrieval.

nodes.label: Headline: composite tracks noise only for larger models
nodes.description: r(noise, composite): Llama-8B -0.91, Qwen-14B -0.95, Qwen-7B -0.93, Qwen-3B TAT-QA -0.90/-0.91, Qwen-7B TAT-QA -0.92; small models inconclusive (Qwen-1.5B -0.27 to -0.61 with CIs spanning +0.75; Qwen-3B dev +0.09). Oracle minus retrieval accuracy +0.144 (Llama-8B), +0.113 (14B), +0.047 (7B, CI spans 0); composite gap +0.049/+0.043/+0.003. Share of weightings passing both criteria: 83.7%, 88.4%, 54.2%, 0-73% on small models.
nodes.norm_label: headline: composite tracks noise only for larger models
